name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low-light settings and improves contrast for data-heavy visuals, which aligns with our goal of clarity and liveliness. The trade-off is that some users may prefer light mode in bright environments, but a toggle keeps the interface flexible without complicating the design.

name: Pane
text: Dark mode hides errors when contrast drops—like Manus’s analysis warns. Light mode risks glare drowning out critical data in bright rooms. A system that auto-switches based on ambient light kills both risks; test it in real lighting conditions to settle the argument.
